name: SBR failed balance hook zeroes the sender
summary: The unverified SBR token takes each sender's balance from an external hook (0xaca4263f) and, when the hook call reverts, writes the caught failure as a zero sender balance. The attacker called skim on the SBR/WETH pair, whose zero-amount self-transfer made the hook revert and erased the pair's SBR balance, then sent it 1 wei of SBR, synced, and sold 54.8e9 wei of SBR for the pair's 8.495 WETH.
notes: Mechanism from the exploit's storage trace, as token and hook are unverified: in the skim the hook's 0x569937dd reverted and the token then stored 0 at the pair's balance slot 0x1395f58d...; the next 1-wei transfer stored 1 there.

Victim is the SBR/WETH pair 0x3431c535, whose LP the deployer sent to 0xdead before the exploit; its WETH came from about 30 buyers in the 350 blocks since launch. No skim or other drain of the pair preceded the anchor (campaign.mjs).
